register_customized_processor: register a custom multimodal processor class mapped to a model config's model_type
create_custom_processor_decorator: create a class decorator that maps a Hugging Face config's model_type to a custom ProcessorMixin
build_custom_mm_processor_mapping: build a mapping from model_type strings to custom processor classes for Hugging Face configs
test_register_decorator: test the register_customized_processor decorator validates model_type attribute presence
review_processor_registry: review the _CUSTOMIZED_MM_PROCESSOR registry dict for custom multimodal processor lookups
